title: Use Conservation of Momentum
text: Calculate the recoil velocity of the rifle $$v_{r}$$ when held tightly against the shoulder, using the effective mass $$m_{r}=28.0\,\text{kg}.$$ Here, $$p_{\text{before}}=0,$$ $$p_{\text{after}}=m_{b}v_{b}+m_{r}v_{r},$$ and $$p_{\text{before}}=p_{\text{after}}$$.
